query: I write code all day. What mechanical keyboard should I get?
atoms: perspective: Developer in open office or shared space
perspective: Developer working from home with no noise constraint
plausible_answers: Answer A (Keychron TKL Linear Default): Get a Keychron Q or V series in TKL with linear switches — the combination of hot-swap customizability, quiet linears for shared spaces, and compact layout is the best all-around choice for daily programming.

Answer B (Tactile for Touch Typing): Choose tactile switches (Boba U4 or Topre) on a 65% if you're a touch typist — the actuation feedback reduces errors and finger fatigue during marathon coding sessions without the noise of clicky switches.

Answer C (65% for Desk Efficiency): Prioritize a 65% form factor above switch choice — keeping your mouse closer and eliminating numpad bulk reduces shoulder strain during long development sessions more than any switch selection.
baseline_answer: Answer A (Keychron TKL Linear Default): Get a Keychron Q or V series in TKL with linear switches — the combination of hot-swap customizability, quiet linears for shared spaces, and compact layout is the best all-around choice for daily programming.
